headline: Going Commando proposals cover Dobbo, Snivelak and near-matching routines
summary: Going Commando received seven new pull requests, but none merged and no commits landed on master. #372 proposes two matching level routines for Dobbo in USA v1.01 and USA v2.00, and Snivelak in those releases and PAL. #373 proposes four more routines and a correction to a callback entry. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: #375 preserves a movie-playback reconstruction whose skip-button test still differs from the original.
#376 preserves an Oozla ring-particle emitter reconstruction. It reaches the original size only with debug compilation enabled, and load orders still differ.
#378 preserves a near-matching text-list drawer, including control-binding labels. These reconstructions remain proposed work, not landed matches.
#374 proposes classifying `func_002A1130` as handwritten assembly, subject to maintainer agreement in review.
#377 records evidence that a shared Barlow and Hrugis Cloud routine includes the preceding function’s tail. The correction is not applied.
